''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

The Wheel of Time translates as '''Колесо Времени''' in Russian, although it has also been published under the name '''Век Дракона''', which translates as ''Dragon Age''. The books are published by Азбука-Аттикус (ABC-Atticus) and previously by other companies, but translations halted with the last book written by Robert Jordan, [[Knife of Dreams]]. 

The remaining books were unofficially translated by a group of Russian fans known as Цитадель Детей Света (Citadel of the Children of the Light). The same group also created audiobook versions of the whole series in the Russian language. 

An official version of the [[New Spring]] short story appeared in a Russian translation of the 1998 anthology Legends in 1999, with a later translation of the full novella.[https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BE_%D0%92%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8] Unoffical translations of [[The World of Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time]], [[The Strike at Shayol Ghul]], [[A Fire Within the Ways]] and [[River of Souls]] were also made by the Citadel of the Children of the Light group.

==Book Covers==

The publishers of the Russian books are somewhat confusing. The rights appear to belong to the parent ACT group, whereas the books have been published by a number of companies or subsidiaries of ACT in Moscow, Saint Petersberg and elsewhere. These companies include Keeper, Terra Fantastica, Azbuka, ABC Atticus, Lux and ACT Publishing House. Apart from these are unofficial versions or completions of the series (see The Citadel of the Children of the Light and My Fantastic Friend.

===Fantastic Library===
These were hardcover editions of the books available up to [[Crossroads of Twilight]]. Later, unofficial versions of [[New Spring]] and [[Knife of Dreams]] through to [[A Memory of Light]] were made by fans to complete their libraries and self-published by a group called Renaissance.[https://fantlab.ru/edition174934][https://fantlab.ru/publisher6624]

===My Fantastic Friend (set 1)===
Unofficial translations of the books from the same group as above, but available in Ukraine. These versions have two different dustcover options. As well as the whole of the original volume, they also commonly contained translated parts of The World of Robert Jordan's Wheel or time or other related works such as [[A Fire Within the Ways]] and [[River of Souls]].[https://fantlab.ru/publisher6013][https://fantlab.ru/edition290633]
